Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Infrastructură de date și analize
At SCOR, we combine the Art and Science of risk to help build more resilient societies. Technology is a vital resource and partner in every step of our journey. We are seeking innovators to join our dynamic tech team of over 200 professionals across three global hubs. Guided by our corporate values-Collaboration, Courage, Care, Open-Mindedness, and Integrity-our teams develop technology that insures the world. Join us and make a difference!
 We are seeking a Data Engineer Team Lead to join our dynamic Tech team. The ideal candidate is an inspirational team lead, problem-solving oriented with strong analytical thinking.
 You will be leading a data engineering team to support the development of data pipelines amongst our IT and Data products and act as a local coordinator to ensure that our central best practices are applied.
 Under the responsibility of a Lead Data Engineer, your mission will be to:
Build, deliver, test, maintain data artefacts such as data pipelines & services (API) to serve data distribution while following standard best practices.
Document data artefacts (code, diagrams, wiki-like documentation) to secure the comprehensiveness of your work.
Collaborate within and outside your squad by partipipating to workshops or rituals (dailys, sprint reviews, design sessions)
Support the delivery of trust-worthy data pipelines that serve both transactional and analytical needs, by implementing adequate tests and controls.
Review and coach data engineers, support them by helping them to grow.
+6 years of experience as a data engineer, data oriented mindset
Proven experience in development and maintenance of data pipelines, preferably in agile projects (Scrum and/or Kanban)
Proven experience with Databricks and/or Palantir Foundry is a strong plus
Experience in (Re)insurance industry and / or Financial Services is a plus
 Technical Skills: 
Strong level in Python, Pyspark and SQL, ability to develop data pipelines under various platform using good practices such as parallelization, distributing programing techniques, decisional modeling, slowly changing dimensions, change data capture management…
Good knowledge of CI / CD pipelines and Gitflows best practices
Knowledge of REST API development
Knowledge of reporting tools (e.g. Power BI) is a plus
 Behavioral & Management Skills: 
Strong analytical thinking, rigorous mindset solution-oriented and force of proposal
Team player, commitment, curiosity, interest to challenge
Capacity to navigate in an international environment
Communication, ability to speak to a wide community of stakeholders (business, data, IT)
 Required Education 
Bachelor's degree in computer science, software or computer engineering, applied math, physics, statistics, or a related field or equivalent experience
